training_labels: Only old24 original 0/1/2 ordinal responses; no new severe, pending or unreviewed labels in fitting.
qualification: Explicit a7ff exposure registry plus original frozen holdout, existing scope/reference gates; no split changes.
purpose: Small model feasibility/identifiability probe, not a required replacement quality formula and not independent validation.
baseline_features: Each of the 15 previous scalar candidates receives its own one-input ordinal model using error=1-Q/100.
likelihood: Three ordered categories: P(Y<=k)=sigmoid(theta_k-X beta), theta_0 < theta_1, beta>=0.
fitting: Deterministic bounded L-BFGS-B from beta=0.1 and smoothed category-frequency cutpoints; analytic gradients.
evaluation: Leave one original development building out; 11 folds over 24 selected observations. Candidate formulas were explored on this development set, so this is a grouped diagnostic, not a clean validation experiment.
outcomes: nonnegative coefficient ranges and zero coefficients
full-fit ranking described separately from cross-fitted diagnostics
sensitivity: Repeat fits after removing T20; full-fit one-neighbor-grade changes for each old24 response within original three categories. No scenario frequencies are probabilities; no individual confidence is invented.
boundary_notes: Hcenter is not an orthogonal variance component across differing footprints.
Features overlap; nonnegative fitted weights do not prove causal independent quality dimensions.
No known severe fourth category exists in this training protocol; no severe threshold is learned.
No person effect or repeated-label causal variance component is fitted.
Equal data and zero hyperparameter search do not mean equal parameter counts: scalar=3, geom4=6, geom5=7.
